# SMK Transmission


> SMK Transmission is a professional power transmission manufacturer founded in 2010. The company manufactures worm gearboxes, hypoid gearboxes, gear motors and electric motors for global industrial customers.


Official website: https://www.smktrans.com/
Contact: info@smktrans.com | +86 152 6257 9178


## Core products


- NMRV, NRV, PCRV and DRV worm gear reducers: https://www.smktrans.com/product-worm-gear-reducer.html
- BKM hypoid gear reducers: https://www.smktrans.com/product-hypoid-gear-reducer.html
- Three-phase, single-phase and brake motors: https://www.smktrans.com/product-electric-motor.html
- AC and DC gear motors: https://www.smktrans.com/product-gear-motor.html


## Applications


SMK products are used in conveyors, packaging machinery, food-processing equipment, agricultural machinery, lifting systems, automation equipment, mixers and general industrial machinery.
- [NMRV130 Worm Gear Reducer: Dimensions, Ratios & Motor Selection](https://www.smktrans.com/news-nmrv130-worm-gearbox-dimensions-ratio-motor-selection.html): 45 mm hollow bore, 7.5–100 ratios, installation dimensions and compatible motor flange options.

## AC geared motor engineering data

- [GH/GV AC Geared Motor Size Chart](https://www.smktrans.com/news-gh-gv-ac-geared-motor-size-chart.html): GH18/GV18 through GH50/GV50, 0.1–3.7 kW, 18–50 mm output shafts, standard ratios 3–200 and combined ratios 250–1800.
